body:
This change translates `IMAD.HI.U32` into `mad.hi.u32` while leaving ordinary `IMAD` on the existing low-product path and preserving `IMAD.WIDE`. Other `IMAD.HI` type forms are diagnosed as unsupported. A directed unit fixture covers the two QKV instruction forms.

Validation: the isolated diff passes `git diff --check`. The unit test has not been run in the upstream workspace because the standalone target lacks its `ptx_parser` dev dependency and a full workspace build requires LLVM setup. The previously prepared combined candidate passed its direct HI fixture and offline full-QKV `ptxas -arch=sm_120` check; those checks do not establish this upstream test as executed. The later real QKV v5 run still ended with sync error 700, so this local instruction correction does not claim whole-kernel correctness.

This PR contains only the `IMAD.HI.U32` change in `ptx/src/sass/lifter.rs`; it does not include FSEL, register-pair, or HBF changes.
